defs: very bad or awful
making you feel upset or afraid
something that is much worse than you wished
exs: The weather was terrible.
We had a terrible storm last night.
The soup tasted terrible.

defs: a large piece of cloth that hangs in front of a stage or window
a cloth that opens and closes on a stage
cloth that covers a window
exs: The curtain opened and the play began.
The red curtain rose on the stage.
Close the curtain so the sun won't wake me.

defs: earned something because of what you did
should get something because it was earned
was worth a reward or a result
exs: She deserved the prize because she worked hard.
The winner deserved a big hug.
He deserved a rest after working so hard.

defs: in an exciting, big way, like an actor
in a big, show-off way like a movie star
in a way that is very exciting to watch
exs: He fell dramatically onto the floor.
She dramatically waved her arms on stage.
The actor dramatically gasped when he saw the ghost.

defs: being ill
the state of not being healthy
when your body feels bad and you have a fever
exs: He stayed home because of his sickness.
Her sickness lasted three days.
The doctor helped him get over his sickness.

defs: a vehicle that travels in space
a vehicle that flies among the stars
a craft that carries people to other planets
exs: The spaceship flew to Mars.
The spaceship landed on the moon.
Carlos built a spaceship out of boxes.

defs: to ruin something
to make something bad or no good
to ruin a fun plan or a nice time
exs: Don't spoil the surprise.
Rain can spoil a picnic.
Don't spoil the ending of the story.

defs: pulling people toward something
drawing people near because it is interesting
making people want to come and look
exs: The bright sign is attracting many people.
The colorful balloons are attracting many kids.
Honey is attracting bees to the garden.

defs: a shop or a company that sells things
a place that makes or sells things for money
a company or shop that people run
exs: His family has a small business.
Her uncle runs a business that sells shoes.
The bakery is a good business.

defs: thin, dry biscuits
small, flat, crunchy snacks
dry baked food often eaten with soup or cheese
exs: I ate crackers with cheese.
We put cheese on the crackers.
Mom packed crackers for our trip.

defs: a large group of people
lots of people gathered in one place
many people standing close together
exs: A big crowd came to the park.
The crowd cheered at the parade.
A crowd waited outside the store.

defs: to get money for work
to get paid for doing a job
to get something because you worked hard
exs: She wants to earn money.
Carlos wants to earn money by washing cars.
You can earn a star by reading every day.

defs: more than usual
added to what you already have
more than what is needed
exs: Please bring extra food.
Take an extra jacket in case it gets cold.
I got extra dessert today.

defs: a store that sells food
a shop where people buy food and drinks
a place to get milk, bread and fruit
exs: We bought milk at the grocery store.
Dad went to the grocery to buy eggs.
The grocery was full of fresh fruit.

defs: the parts of your body at the sides, below your waist
the body parts where your legs join your body
the sides of your body under your waist
exs: She put her hands on her hips.
He danced and moved his hips.
The girl put her hands on her hips.

defs: in a way that shows you wish for something
wishing very much that something good will happen
with a wish that things will work out
exs: She looked at the door hopefully.
Carlos looked hopefully at the cookie jar.
Mosh waited hopefully by the door for a walk.

defs: to speak quietly and not clearly
to talk in a soft way so people can't hear
to say words that are hard to understand
exs: Please don't mumble. Speak loudly.
The shy boy began to mumble his answer.
Don't mumble when you read aloud.

defs: small amounts of something to try
little bits of food or goods to try for free
small amounts that show what something is like
exs: The shop gave free samples of cookies.
The store gave out samples of cheese.
We tried samples of the new juice.

defs: a machine that makes sounds louder
a box that plays music or voices loudly
something that makes sound come out louder
exs: The voice came from the speaker on the wall.
Turn up the speaker so we can hear.
Music played from the speaker in the corner.
